Executes single transactions, commits results, and publishes replay and signature messages.

# Purpose
The `exec` tile implements transaction execution in the runtime pipeline. It receives parsed transaction messages from the replay path, selects the target bank, executes the transaction with `fd_runtime_prepare_and_execute_txn`, and commits the result to the accounts database through `fd_runtime_finalize_txn` when execution succeeds. The tile also handles transaction signature verification messages, forwards transaction signatures to the `exec_sig` link for later deduplication, and sends completion messages back to replay. It uses `fd_stem` as the tile message loop and defines the tile entry point `fd_tile_execor`.

The file also sets up the execution context and all required shared objects during [`unprivileged_init`](<#unprivileged_init>). It joins the bank set, `funk` accounts database, program cache, transaction cache, bank hash compare object, and per-tile scratch allocator. It also creates optional capture support for protocol dumps and Solana capture output. The file defines seccomp and file descriptor policies for the tile, writes execution metrics for the program cache, and publishes buffered capture account updates before later transaction completion messages.
